svg.title: AWS Organization structure for a tech company
svg.desc: Hierarchical tree showing Management Root, then Security/Shared Services/Workloads/Clients OUs, with sub-OUs and accounts under each

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What policies should I apply at the AWS Organization root level?')
sendPrompt('What accounts should live in the Security OU of an AWS Organization?')
sendPrompt('What shared services accounts should I create in AWS Organizations?')
sendPrompt('How should I organize product workloads in AWS sub-accounts?')
sendPrompt('How should I manage client accounts in AWS Organizations for a managed services company?')
sendPrompt('What is an AWS audit account used for?')
sendPrompt('What is a log archive account in AWS?')
sendPrompt('What goes into a network hub account in AWS?')
sendPrompt('What is a tooling account in AWS for CI/CD and IaC?')
sendPrompt('What is a shared services monitoring account in AWS?')
sendPrompt('How should I structure external product accounts with dev/staging/prod environments in AWS?')
sendPrompt('How should I structure internal tool accounts in AWS?')
sendPrompt('What resources typically go into a dev account in AWS?')
sendPrompt('What is a staging account used for in AWS?')
sendPrompt('What special guardrails should a production AWS account have?')
sendPrompt('Should each client get their own AWS account or sub-OU?')
sendPrompt('How do I add a new client OU in OpenTofu for AWS Organizations?')
sendPrompt('What resources go in a client dev account vs prod account in a managed services setup?')
sendPrompt('What special guardrails should a client production AWS account have?')

svg.text: Security OU — audit trail, log archive, GuardDuty aggregation
Shared Services OU — network hub, CI/CD tooling, observability
Workloads OU — your external & internal products, per-env accounts
Clients OU — one sub-OU per client, own dev/prod accounts
Root SCPs → inherited by all OUs and accounts
Workloads/External Prod gets stricter SCPs (no IAM admin, no public S3)
Clients OU gets client-specific guardrails + billing tagging enforcement
